title: Certify actual R437 descendant ingress and binary-Count stock guard
body:
PR4732 stopped after an authenticated root's actual Program/row handoff. This package passes that produced child capsule and its actual grant words into `Machine.new_context`, then executes the unchanged first 15 statements of `Machine.node` through the local stock guard. The real `SelectedBinding.incoming` / `Callback` returns coefficient **2**; real binary-Count operations preserve incoming **R/A** and produce local unused **R/A²**, divisible by 9475.

Nine controls are rejected by the actual ingress (runtime width/depth, selected rank, unit, field/source association, high digit and both row guards). A doubled-stock control passes local divisibility but fails the separate exact parent-row correspondence, distinguishing the two obligations. Program/directory/source bytes and heads, Count values and heads, and numerical live sets are checked; expected normalization of three padded Count tapes is explicitly disclosed.

Only `research/r437-descendant-ingress/` is added. The original 2048→64 handoff is reused as setup and credited to PR4732, not claimed anew. This is a historical **q3,w1 semantic fixture**, below numerical admission, with empty source payload. The prefix is invoked directly after root `checked_entry` returns; there is no recursive dispatcher, full node, second STEP, next-child row observation, physical tariff, smaller-stock installation or κ claim. The authenticated historical loader projection and inherited geometry adapter are disclosed. PR3957's earlier nested physical protocol and PR4685's arithmetic stock proof are not rederived; the selected κ remains 0.00302015.

Validation on exact head `4e87d59fa173ae5a3ebf7106ce03f43f14d9065c`, macOS/Darwin 27 arm64, Python 3.12.2:

- Registered ordinary and optimized replay pass; metadata/pins and 9 actual ingress controls plus 1 separate correspondence rejection pass. Each replay takes about 25 seconds locally.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes for 409 files; declared Git ancestry depends only on canonical main `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`.
- Committed export integrity and ordinary/optimized Git-free replay pass. Mutated retained executable and live caller input reject before import; all 410 exported files remain byte-identical after restoration.
- The changed-package planner selects only this package. Independent agent source/boundary review found no material mismatch; its suggested direct binding to `s.spec.low` was applied. This review was read-only, not independent human/formal-kernel acceptance.

Submission refresh retained canonical main and priority revision 7. Fresh overlap covers 499 open PRs, 3648 Discussion records and all 5860 base local notes (5862 including this new package), with complete pagination/inventory. Targeted follow-up search found the predecessor handoff and this claim, not another actual-ingress join. Closed PR bodies/code diffs/history are not exhaustive coverage. Live predecessor heads remain PR4732 `1d5ab443e74bad0e28f248657706399374ea97a5` and PR4685 `ca336bd72aff54e025a8ddbb1f3c8b756d9b9631`.

[Canonical investigation and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4682#discussioncomment-19130296). Next useful work is the actual next leaf producer/STEP at width 2 or a bounded admitted root; ingress success does not remove complete payload/backing and tariff obligations.

Credit Mihir Srivastava/PR4685; Brian/PR4732; Chris R/Clear1nsight's R437/compiler/caller work; unpaidmoon; Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml, David Arias, Nick Petalas, ywz65, Tekalign and the retained R437/source/hosting lineage. Brian (JoyboyBrian), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
